svg.title: The star-and-sparkle cheek design in four steps, on brown skin. 1: sponge a curved swoosh from the cheek up toward the ear, pink at the bottom, then purple, then blue at the top, staying well below the eye. 2: a big yellow star on the cheek, two small stars higher up and a pink heart. 3: thin black outlines. Done: white shine lines, sparkles and dots.
